title: Rather flimsey
text: Rather flimsey. Very disappointed for the money spent. The acrylic material will scratch easily, the lids do not come off for easy washing, although they did dry quickly after washing. I do like how they look on the counter. The lids do fit very tight so no moisture will get in. Over all, I like them, but I'm disappointed for the money I spent. The acrylic should be thicker.
